normalization_policy: normalized claim plus artifact and evidence target; no voting

findings.claim: The immutable pre-effect accounting entry required for completion and index-close attempts cannot carry the AdministrativeResourceLedger contract's actual result and before/after artifact hashes, and no post-effect ledger closure record is defined.
findings.evidence_excerpt: Before each later deterministic file effect, it pre-appends a fixed contract-priced attempt entry
findings.impact: The protocol must either record predicted outcome evidence as if it were actual or fail reconciliation after charge, weakening accounting integrity or stranding a charged attempt before dispatch.
findings.recommended_action: Define separate immutable pre-effect attempt authorization and post-effect outcome records, bind both in the validator and receipts, and require their closed pair before completion, index closure, or dispatch.

findings.claim: The INTENT_INDEX_OPEN_PENDING abandonment path permits NOT_APPLIED closure without explicitly restoring the missing OPEN, although ordered CLOSE requires a matching OPEN and root/index one-to-one reconciliation.
findings.evidence_excerpt: permits only the exact idempotent index-open recovery or, while ledger bytes still equal source, the pre-bound NOT_APPLIED close path
findings.impact: A crash after intent persistence can leave no valid closed index state; accepting an orphan CLOSE weakens lineage, while rejecting it strands admission with no exact abandonment sequence.
findings.recommended_action: Specify one deterministic recovery sequence that first appends and validates the missing OPEN before NOT_APPLIED completion and matching CLOSE, or define a separate pre-OPEN abandonment record and validator rule that preserves one-to-one reconciliation.

findings.claim: No executable same-attempt recovery is defined when ledger bytes equal the charged candidate but GuardedWriteReceipt persistence crashed; the text names only an unspecified HUMAN recovery or migration even though migration is defined as one-time pre-WBS maintenance.
findings.evidence_excerpt: Candidate equality without that receipt—including crash before receipt persistence—or any receipt mismatch enters `TRANSITION_RECOVERY_BLOCKED` and must not create APPLIED
findings.impact: A foreseeable crash immediately after the charge write can permanently strand the charged attempt and break ledger lineage, leaving the partial-commit control without the required owner-bound recovery path.
findings.recommended_action: Define an explicit TRANSITION_RECOVERY_BLOCKED owner and exact same-attempt terminal-recovery protocol that independently verifies persisted bytes, preserves the charge, never fabricates APPLIED evidence, and records a validator-accepted failed/unknown lineage link with bounded accounting.
